name: Bishop Fan Club
description: Every promotion must create a bishop, and primary king and queen moves must be diagonal.
ambiguities: Castling is forbidden because its primary king move is orthogonal. Promotion is classified by the primary pawn mover but its result is required to be a bishop.

name: Rook Fan Club
description: Every promotion must create a rook, and primary king and queen moves must be orthogonal.
ambiguities: Castling remains allowed because its primary king move is orthogonal. Promotion is classified by the primary pawn mover but its result is required to be a rook.

name: Respectful
description: The affected player cannot make a move that gives check.
ambiguities: Check is evaluated from the complete resulting position, including discovered, promotion, en-passant, and castling-rook attacks. Checkmate is also forbidden.

name: Shapeshifter
description: The original queen begins bishop-like and copies each non-pawn type captured by any own piece; copying a knight freezes it.
ambiguities: Only the original queen is tracked; promoted queens are unrestricted. Every own primary capture of a non-pawn changes the mode, even when another piece captures. All reachable copied geometries are standard-queen move subsets. Reconstruction assumes history from the standard game start.

name: Fischer Random
description: By turn twenty, every surviving own non-pawn piece must occupy the home rank on a file where that current piece type could not have started.
ambiguities: The deadline counts affected-player turns. The arrangement must remain valid after turn twenty. Promoted pieces use their current type's standard starting files; captured pieces are ignored.

name: Unspooling
description: The affected player's primary moves share a budget of 100 Manhattan-distance units.
ambiguities: Distance is Manhattan distance between primary endpoints. Castling costs the king's distance only. A move may spend the final unit; exhaustion is a loss at the beginning of the affected player's next turn under the project-wide loss timing policy. Standard checkmate on the final-unit move ends the game before that later loss can occur. If every legal move costs more than the remaining budget, the generic no-drawback-legal-move loss applies.

name: Blinded by the Sun
description: The affected player cannot end a move pseudo-attacking one hidden central square.
ambiguities: The 14 observed site samples contain only d4, e4, d5, and e5; this is treated as the executable parameter domain but does not prove the official domain. Attacking means resulting-position pseudo-attack, so pinned pieces still attack.
